checks.check: naming + 3×21 frames 512×512 RGBA (P0 grid) + UI 64² icon / 96×56 chip
alpha sanity: no edge clipping, non-empty, mostly opaque, exactly 1 connected piece per frame (no floating bits)
edge fringe: semi-transparent edge = outline colour, alpha-0 halo colour-bled (no black/white fringe)

alignment: item centroid fixed in its anchor's local frame every frame (pin/wreath ≤1.5px; cape collar ≤4px incl. sway) and sits on body (pin ≥95% on tunic, wreath ≥55% on hair/head, cape ≥25% behind torso)
wreath (with outfit_head hidden): never below brow, eyes clear, no face-skin coverage
cape: z=6 behind sword(10)/arms(20,70)/head(30) so it can't cover face, weapon or arms; collar attached at chest-top every frame; class back hidden
acorn pin visible ≥50% in ≥15/21 frames (rest may be hidden by arm/shield, accepted by DES-04b §6.2)
atlases ≤2048², JSON Hash valid, rects in bounds, frame names = files, pixel-exact reconstruction
manifest: every animation frameName exists in its atlas, paths exist, ids/slot/z/hideRules (back; whole outfit_head) correct
